title: Tanker LIPSI hit by projectile in Strait of Hormuz
excerpt: UKMTO reports a tanker struck in the Strait of Hormuz on 4 October, engine room damaged, with Vanguard Tech identifying the vessel as LIPSI. A tanker also reported explosions south of Al-Mokha.
